Your in-flight is1.6 work is blocking the shared test gate — 2 red tests in the tree right now:

`socket_path_follows_xdg_config_home` + `socket_path_falls_back_to_home_dot_config` fail: code produces `{XDG}/flywheel/herdr/herdr.sock`, tests expect `{XDG}/herdr/herdr.sock`.

Root cause: `socket_path()` uses `config_dir()` which appends `flywheel` (it's `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/flywheel`). Your tests encode the correct intent (herdr's socket lives directly under the XDG root, per toron-core's herdr client). Fix: compute the XDG ROOT, not `config_dir()` — e.g. `std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME").map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|_| home_dir().join(".config")).join("herdr/herdr.sock")`.

My cg6.3 work (durable.rs/state.rs/main.rs) is test-complete and waiting on this gate. Land the fix and I'll run the full suite.
